# sknet

> See the traffic between your networks.

sknet is an skstacks service for network flow visibility across mesh hops. Small softflowd exporters
on each gateway or hop send unsampled NetFlow v9 over UDP to one collector. On that collector,
Akvorado (inlet, Kafka, outlet, ClickHouse, console) keeps an estate-wide flow history on local disk
with a TTL and a disk budget, and ntopng Community runs on the gateway host as a memory-capped live
view. Both web UIs sit behind Traefik with SSO and a per-router CIDR allowlist for mesh and LAN
addresses only, and the collector ports accept flows only from listed exporter addresses. Isolated
sites get exactly one one-way telemetry exception: UDP to the collector's flow port, from the
exporter address, to one collector. sknet keeps the upstream applications and logos unmodified and
pins every image by tag. Built on Akvorado (AGPL-3.0) and ntopng Community (GPLv3).

## About smilinTux

sknet is part of the **smilinTux sovereign AI ecosystem**, a suite of open-source tools built by
its creators to give humans and AI agents genuine, authentic infrastructure they can own and
trust. No corporate clouds, no black-box SaaS middlemen. MIT License.

Other ecosystem projects: [SKWorld](https://skworld.io), [SKStacks](https://skstacks.skworld.io), [sksec](https://sksec.skworld.io), [skhub](https://skhub.skworld.io), [skgateway](https://skgateway.skworld.io), [skpatch](https://skpatch.skworld.io)
